title: TAVI API — restore a record whose unique value is now taken (NDC-1603), 26 Oct 2026
lines: QA W5 Email set as unique on QA W5 Module (PATCH constraints -> 200)
Record A with qa.w5.unq@example.com -> deleted -> record B created with the same email (201)
"QA W5 Email is already in use by another record."  A stays deleted (GET -> 404)
Unique check on create is case-insensitive: QA.W5.R1@example.com refused when qa.w5.r1@ exists (422)
